opportunities.name: Booking.com flight search, select fastest and continue
opportunities.description: Search one-way or multi-city flights on Booking.com by origin, destination, departure date(s) and passenger count, sort by Fastest, pick a flight and advance through ticket type.
steps: Open Booking.com and click the Flights tab.
Set trip type (One way, or Multi-city) and check Direct flights only if wanted.
Type the origin in the first 'From' field and pick the matching airport from the dropdown.
Type the destination in the 'Where to?' field and pick the matching airport.
For multi-city, add each further leg and type its origin and destination.
Open the departure date picker and click the required day(s).
Set passengers (adults) in the travellers control and click Done.
Click Search.
On results, click the 'Fastest' tab.
Click 'See flight' on the first result, then 'Select' in the fare dialog.
Click 'Next' on the ticket-type page.

instances.values: One-way BLR Bangalore -> GOI Goa (Panaji), 29 Mar 2023, 2 adults, direct only, Fastest, first flight selected.
Multi-city NYC New York -> Tokyo (TYO) on 1 Jun 2023, Tokyo -> Delhi (DEL) on 5 Jun 2023, 1 adult, Fastest, first flight selected.

opportunities.name: Expedia car rental search by pick-up location, dates and times
opportunities.description: Search Expedia Cars for a rental by pick-up location, optional separate drop-off, pick-up and drop-off dates and times, and optionally sort the results.
steps: Open Expedia and click the Cars tab.
Click the Pick-up field, type the location, and choose the matching result.
Set Drop-off to 'Same as pick-up', or type and choose a different drop-off location.
Open the Pick-up date picker, click the start date, click the end date, then click Done.
Select the pick-up time and drop-off time from their dropdowns.
Click Search.
Optionally change the Sort by dropdown on results (e.g. Total Price).

instances.values: Pick-up and drop-off JFK New York, 3 Apr to 6 Apr 2023, 9:00 am pick-up, 6:00 pm drop-off, results sorted by Total Price.
Pick-up San Francisco, 2 Apr to 8 Apr 2023 (drop-off 3 Apr then 9 Apr), default times 10:30 am, Search clicked.

opportunities.name: Carnival cruise search by destination, departure port, dates and guests
opportunities.description: Filter Carnival cruises by region (Sail To), departure port (Sail From), month of sailing (Dates) and guest count, then run the search.
steps: Click the 'Sail To' control and choose the destination region button.
Click the 'Sail From' control and choose the departure port.
Optionally click 'Dates' and choose the target month and year.
Optionally click 'Number of Guests' and set the guest count, then click Done.
Click 'SEARCH CRUISES'.
Read the result count and cruise cards.

instances.values: Sail To Panama Canal, Sail From San Francisco CA, dates October 2024, search run.
Sail To Caribbean, guests changed from 2 to 4 (then to 3 and 4 as shown), search run.

opportunities.name: SpotHero airport parking search
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero parking near an airport by typing the airport, choosing it, setting start and end dates, and optionally sorting results.
steps: Open SpotHero and click the Airport tab.
Type the airport name or code in the 'Airport Name, Code or City' search box.
Click the matching airport in the suggestion list.
Open the Parking Start Date picker and click the start date; set the end date the same way.
Change the sort dropdown (Featured) if needed.
Read the parking spot results.

instances.values: John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), start 18 Apr 2023, end 20 Apr 2023, sort set to Shuttle Time.
Dallas Love Field (DAL), no dates set.

opportunities.name: MTA planned service changes lookup by route and date
opportunities.description: Look up planned subway service changes on the MTA site for a chosen route and date.
steps: Open the MTA site and open the menu (or use the 'Planned Work' link) to reach Planned Service Changes.
Click the 'Search Routes' box and type the route ID (e.g. S92 or 4).
Click the matching route in the list; the route is shown as selected.
Optionally open the 'Select Date' picker, move to the target month and click the day.
Read the 'Results for' section.

instances.values: Route 4, date changed to 3 May 2023 via next-month navigation.

opportunities.name: Delta SkyMiles Deals search by origin and destination
opportunities.description: Search Delta SkyMiles Deals fares by origin airport, destination airport and region, then submit the filter.
steps: Open the SkyMiles tab and click 'SkyMiles Award Deals'.
Click the Origin combobox and choose the origin airport.
Click the Destination combobox and choose the destination airport.
Click the 'Filters' button.
Open 'Select Region Type' and choose the region (e.g. Domestic & North America).
Click the filter submit arrow to load deals.

instances.values: Origin CMH Columbus, OH (origin opened; destination not recorded in the trace).
Origin PHL Philadelphia, PA; destination ATL Atlanta, GA; region Domestic & North America.
